start: A workout open in MettleUp, a set with a rest time

steps.action: Tick the set in the app, then leave the app (home button)
user_sees: A rest card in the notification shade: a countdown line ('2:53 left'), 'Next: <exercise, set>', buttons 'Done', '+15 s', 'Skip'; the live workout card goes down while it shows
must_not: Two MettleUp workout notifications at once
The card making a sound or buzzing at the rest start

user_sees: The countdown 15 s longer; the app's own timer shows the same end when opened
must_not: The app and the card showing different end times
The card jumping to the top with a sound

user_sees: The rest card goes; the live workout card comes back
must_not: A 'Rest is over' later for the skipped rest

start: A rest card in the shade, phone locked

steps.action: Tap the card body (not a button)
user_sees: MettleUp opens on the open workout
must_not: MettleUp opening on the home tab
The rest being skipped by opening the app

start: MettleUp swiped away from recents, live workout card in the shade

steps.action: Tap 'Complete set' on the live card
user_sees: The phone starts the rest on its own: rest card with countdown and 'Next: ...'
must_not: No rest because the app's JS was not running
The set ticked twice when the app is opened

start: Notifications for MettleUp blocked in Android settings, a workout open

steps.action: Tick a set and leave the app
user_sees: No rest card; the in-app timer still runs and shows the rest when the app is opened
must_not: A crash or an error pop-up
The rest lost in the app

steps.action: After 'Rest is over' already came, tap '+15 s' on an old copy of the card (if any)
must_not: A new rest started from nowhere

start: A rest card in the shade

steps.action: Swipe the rest card away (or 'Clear all') mid-rest
user_sees: The live workout card comes back with 'Complete set'; 'Rest is over' still comes at the end
must_not: No notification left for the rest of the rest
The end alert lost because the card was swiped

steps.action: Tick the last set of the workout
user_sees: The rest card says 'All sets done · Finish when ready' instead of a next set
must_not: 'Next:' naming a set that does not exist

start: A rest card in the shade, phone locked on a gym bench

user_sees: The countdown and 'Next: <exercise, set>' shown on the lock screen; the countdown channel never makes a sound
must_not: The countdown channel making a sound
Any gym or personal detail beyond the exercise and set
